##### Maintenance

- Update go.yaml.in/yaml/v3 to v3.0.5 \[[`d547015`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/d547015)]
- Releases are now cut by a GitHub Actions workflow (Actions -> Release -> Run workflow) rather than by hand, with changelog entries collected under `## Unreleased` as the work happens.  Releases still ship the stripped-down tree on `master-lite` - tests removed and Ginkgo dropped from `go.mod` - and the workflow now builds it and checks it on every push.  See RELEASING.md. \[[`e9dc84d`](https://redirect.github.com/onsi/gomega/commit/e9dc84d)]
